title: OllamaOpt
description: Enterprise-grade local LLM optimization engine for Intel AI PCs. Orchestrates workload routing between NPU and iGPU for maximum throughput.
detailedStory: Developed to solve memory contention issues in local AI development. This tool provides a 'Hybrid Booster' mode that intelligently segments inference tasks.

title: AICodex
description: A comprehensive knowledge base and code generation pipeline for Senior AI Engineers, designed for rapid prototyping and architecture mapping.
detailedStory: AICodex serves as the brain for the AdaptivConcept™ ecosystem, automating documentation and initial code structure generation.

title: MediMixDash Saga
description: High-performance medical dashboard with a 'Saga' state management pattern. Designed for real-time surgical procedure tracking and hospital resource allocation.
detailedStory: This project showcases how complex medical data can be managed with high reliability and visual clarity in high-pressure environments.

title: WaveShooter
description: A performance-optimized 3D wave-based survival game built with Three.js and custom physics, pushing the limits of browser-based 3D rendering.
detailedStory: Experimental game development focused on spatial partitioning and high-count particle systems in the browser.

title: Surgical Listing App
description: Digital coordination platform for surgical procedure listings, reducing scheduling errors by 40% in large-scale provincial health facilities.
detailedStory: Real-world impact project that transformed manual paperwork into a streamlined digital workflow for surgical teams.

title: Onefit.app
description: Community-centric fitness and wellness platform connecting trainers with trainees.
detailedStory: A platform built to empower fitness enthusiasts through instruction and community connectivity.

title: 3D Studio
description: Advanced 3D visualization for medical assessment and physical therapy.
detailedStory: A mock application using Three.js to indicate temperature, pain, and strain on 3D body models.
